title: The Human Circulatory System
text: The circulatory system, centered on the heart, transports blood, oxygen, nutrients, and waste products throughout the body via a network of arteries, veins, and capillaries. The heart, a four-chambered muscular pump, beats roughly 60-100 times per minute at rest, circulating about 5 liters of blood. Arteries carry oxygen-rich blood away from the heart; veins return oxygen-depleted blood to it. The system also plays a key role in immune defense and temperature regulation.
